description: Compare two runs: the verdict, metric deltas (metrics), categorized findings delta (findings), the stage pairs (stagePairs) with the share of executor run time they cover (runtimeCoverage), and comparability: the configuration differences, plan equality, data volume, executor capacity and the factors that bridge the wall-clock difference. confidence is ok, low or insufficient. The result names both Spark applications (baselineApp, candidateApp) and the build that wrote it (generator). Each findings row lists its stage names in stages and the same names without call-site directories in stageLabels. A run id is a handle for the run this server process has cached. It differs per server process, so match runs by app.id and app.attemptId, not by run id.

baselineRunId.description: The baseline run, by the run id of an earlier call.

candidateRunId.description: The candidate run, by the run id of an earlier call.

executorRatio.description: Factor by which mean executors must differ, either way, for the verdict to say the wall-clock change reflects executor availability (default 1.5). Sets comparability.caveats.executors.

ignoreConf.description: Regular expressions matched against Spark configuration keys. A key that matches is left out of comparability.conf, for keys that differ by design such as a per-run output path. Per-run identity keys (application id, start time, driver address) are always left out.

include.description: Extra blocks to return. stagePairs: one row per paired stage with its deltas, which can be large.

noiseBand.description: Share of the baseline value under which a metric row is marked withinNoise (default 0.02). Never changes a row's direction.

normalizePath.description: Regular expressions whose every match in a plan node's text is replaced with a fixed token before stages are paired, so run-specific text (an output directory that differs per run) does not keep the same stage from pairing. A generic pattern, not only for paths. Affects stage pairing, runtimeCoverage and confidence, never findings. A pattern that backtracks catastrophically can stall the server: keep them simple and anchored.

taskCountChange.description: Relative task-count change above which the verdict calls out the task count change (default 0.25). Sets comparability.caveats.taskCount.

unmatchedShare.description: Share of the baseline's stages that pair with no candidate stage above which the verdict says the plans differ (default 0.2). Sets comparability.caveats.unmatchedStages.

name: compare_runs
